purpose: Tuning for the scripted movement (web-swing, wall-crawl, web-zip, flight between swings). Each row becomes one constant in generated code.

rows.doc: Gravity while hanging from a web. A bit stronger than real so swings feel snappy.
Extra push along the swing while holding forward.
Speed cap while swinging or flying.
A web must stick at least this far above the player.
Web shortens this fast while the swing key is held.
Upward kick when letting go of a web.
If the aim ray misses, try again this many degrees above the look direction.
Gravity in flight between swings.
Air control from the movement keys.
Collision radius used for the scripted movement raycasts.
Walls lower than this are vaulted normally instead of crawled.
Distance kept between the body and the wall.
Body pitch against the wall (90 = flat against it). 0 keeps the body upright.
Leap speed when jumping off a wall.
Web-zip ends this close to its target.
How long Get Over Here! takes to pull a target in.
Pose used while swinging, flying and crawling.

_source.value: BohemiaInteractive/DayZ-Samples Test_ScriptCmdSwim binds CMD_Swim from a HumanCommandScript

rows.doc: Swim-stroke speed variable (0 idle .. 3 fast).
Stroke speed while swinging (0 = still pose).
Stroke speed while crawling and moving.
